explanations.headline: No. 10's run pulls defender away from teammate

claims.text: North London Red's No. 10 ran far, dragging the defender marking them well away.
This opened up a big space where the pass was received.
Just over two seconds after the pass, the teammate took a shot.

explanations.headline: The runner’s movement pulled the marker away, creating space for a teammate

claims.text: H10 made a 14.5-metre run that caused marker A6 to follow over 9.6 metres with a very closely matched direction.
A6’s distance to the receiving zone increased from 5.0 to 11.1 metres between the start and the moment the ball was played.
This created a space where the nearest defender was 11.1 metres away when the pass was played, leading to a shot 2.2 seconds later.

explanations.headline: Runner H10 created space by dragging marker A6 from receiving zone

claims.text: At 6.0 seconds, player H10 moved 14.5 metres over the 5 seconds before the pass with 0.9 confidence from the detector.
The marker A6 moved 9.6 metres in the same period following H10 with a marker follow cosine of 0.99, indicating closely matched movement directions.
The marker’s distance to the receiving zone increased from 5.0 metres at the run start to 11.1 metres when the pass was played, creating the space.
The nearest defender to the receiving zone also moved from 5.0 metres to 11.1 metres during this time, and the shot occurred 2.2 seconds after the pass.

explanations.headline: No. 8 starts a quick one-two to unlock defence

claims.text: North London Red's No. 8 passed to No. 6 to begin the move.
No. 6 returned the ball past two South Coast Blue defenders shortly after.
The sequence gained 24 metres and led to a shot within six seconds.

explanations.headline: One-two pass sequence bypassed two opponents and advanced attack

claims.text: Player H8 started the attack with a pass at 2.4 seconds, followed by player H6 returning a line-breaking pass at 3.1 seconds that bypassed two opponents, A10 and A11.
This one-two sequence involved three passes from the origin to the shot and progressed the ball 24 metres toward the goal.
The chance began 5.8 seconds before the shot, with the key pass starting 3.6 seconds before the final assist.

explanations.headline: One-two sequence initiated by H8 bypassed opponents and led to a shot

claims.text: At 2.4 seconds, H8 played the origin pass of a one-two sequence with 0.78 confidence.
The line-breaking return pass from H6 to H8 at 3.1 seconds bypassed two opponents, A10 and A11.
From the origin pass to the shot, the team made three passes and progressed 24.0 metres toward the goal.
The chance started 5.8 seconds before the shot and 3.6 seconds before the final pass.
